mcp_tools.name: cash_flow_forecast
mcp_tools.title: Cash-flow forecast
mcp_tools.description: Submits a declared cash-flow forecast artifact (flows and lags, thirteen-week forecast, reserves and runway, working capital and levers, stress tests, reporting and commitments) and returns a deterministic CASH_FLOW_FORECAST_READY / CASH_FLOW_FORECAST_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed weekly-balance, reserve-target and runway re-derivations and stress-case coverage, with per-check evidence. Validates the declared forecast; it produces none.

inputSchema.description: The cash-flow forecast artifact manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

forecast.description: Thirteen-week forecast evidence, including weekly entries.

expect.notes: All arithmetic matches over 13 weekly buckets (opening 1000, +500/-200 per week, cumulative closings 1300..4900): computed_final_balance=4900.000000; reserve 100*2=200; runway 1000/100=10. [Tester correction: designer supplied only 1 weekly bucket, which would fail forecast_covers_thirteen_weeks (SERVICE.md requires exactly 13); expanded to 13 buckets. Designer also omitted the structured computed_spot_checks; added.]
